mapper.select: SELECT DATE(order_time) AS orderDate, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS turnover FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND order_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(order_time) ORDER BY orderDate

SELECT DATE(order_time) AS orderDate, COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS validOrderCount FROM orders WHERE order_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE(order_time) ORDER BY orderDate

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS userDate, COUNT(*) AS totalUserCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = DATE(#{begin}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newUserCount FROM `user` WHERE create_time <= #{end} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY userDate

SELECT od.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(od.number), 0) AS number FROM order_detail od LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 5 AND o.order_time BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY od.name ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 10
